rows.answer: Employees get 22 days of annual leave per calendar year [hb-07-chunk-0].
Passwords need to be changed every 90 days. [hb-05-chunk-0]
Each employee has a training budget of 800 EUR per year for courses, conferences and certifications. [hb-08-chunk-0]
A laptop replacement can take up to 5 business days for handover. [hb-01-chunk-1]

You can expect the setup of your new laptop, including file transfer, account access, email, and other necessary configurations, to be completed within up to 5 business days after manager approval. [hb-01-chunk-1]
You can work remotely up to 3 days per week. [hb-03-chunk-0]
IT support hours are from 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. [hb-10-chunk-0]
Travel receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your return, through the finance app. [hb-04-chunk-0]

You report lost or stolen devices to security first, then request a replacement laptop in the IT portal under Hardware; handover can take up to 5 business days after manager approval. [hb-01-chunk-1][hb-01-chunk-2]
